example.chinese: 我每天晚上十点上床睡觉。
example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wǎn shàng shí diǎn shàng chuáng shuì jiào.
example.english: I go to bed at 10 pm every night.

example.pinyin: Zhè ge zhěn tou hěn ruǎn.
example.english: This pillow is very soft.

example.chinese: 晚上冷的时候我会盖毯子。
example.pinyin: Wǎn shàng lěng de shí hou wǒ huì gài tǎn zi.
example.english: I cover myself with a blanket when it's cold at night.

example.pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu huàn yī cì chuáng dān.
example.english: I change the sheets once a week.

example.pinyin: Zhè ge chuáng diàn tài yìng le.
example.english: This mattress is too hard.

example.chinese: 我的衣柜里有很多衣服。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de yī guì lǐ yǒu hěn duō yī fu.
example.english: There are many clothes in my wardrobe.

example.chinese: 她把化妆品放在梳妆台上。
example.pinyin: Tā bǎ huà zhuāng pǐn fàng zài shū zhuāng tái shàng.
example.english: She puts her cosmetics on the dresser.

example.chinese: 我每天早晨在镜子前刷牙。
example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo chén zài jìng zi qián shuā yá.
example.english: I brush my teeth in front of the mirror every morning.

example.chinese: 我的手机放在床头柜上。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu jī fàng zài chuáng tóu guì shàng.
example.english: My phone is on the nightstand.

example.pinyin: Wǒ wǎn shàng yòng tái dēng kàn shū.
example.english: I use a lamp to read at night.

example.chinese: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de nào zhōng měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn xiǎng.
example.english: My alarm clock goes off at 7 am every morning.

example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wài tào guà zài yī jià shàng.
example.english: Please hang the coat on the hanger.

example.chinese: 我的鞋子都放在壁橱里。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de xié zi dōu fàng zài bì chú lǐ.
example.english: All my shoes are in the closet.

example.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ wà zi fàng zài chōu ti lǐ.
example.english: I put my socks in the drawer.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zhōu mò yào xǐ yī fu.
example.english: I need to do laundry this weekend.

example.chinese: 请把脏衣服放进脏衣篮。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zāng yī fu fàng jìn zāng yī lán.
example.english: Please put the dirty clothes in the hamper.

example.pinyin: Kè tīng de dì tǎn hěn piào liang.
example.english: The rug in the living room is very beautiful.

example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chuāng lián lā shàng.

example.pinyin: Qǐng dǎ kāi chuāng hu ràng xīn xiān kōng qì jìn lái.
example.english: Please open the window to let fresh air in.

example.chinese: 我把家人的照片放在相框里。

example.english: I put family photos in the photo frame.

example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān xiě rì jì.

example.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huān zài chuáng shàng kàn shū.
example.english: I like to read books in bed.

example.pinyin: Hái zi men zài wán wán jù.

example.pinyin: Wǒ shuì jiào qián huàn shàng shuì yī.

example.pinyin: Xià tiān wǒ kāi fēng shàn shuì jiào.

example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yī fu dié hǎo.

example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wài tào guà zài yī guì lǐ.

example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
example.english: I wake up at 7 am every morning.

example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng pū chuáng.
